Mefis the Jailer is the first boss of the dungeon, this boss is a typical "mini-boss" styled encounter, dealing magic auto-attacks and low upfront damage to the player.
Mefis will teleport to different floors after

• 1 Person: 50k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 2 People: 100k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 3 People: 150k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 4 People: 200k Damage before the jailer teleports
• 5 People: 250k Damage before the jailer teleports
To unlock Eterna's doorway you must find two crystal pylon locations see
Eterna is the last boss of the dungeon, this boss has multiple high hitting mechanics and does alternating magic / ranged auto-attacks throughout the fight.

⬥ Deal damage until Eterna phases
    • Eterna will spawn a single Chaos Demon Savage after phasing, kill them to move into phase 2.

⬥ Eterna re-appears with full HP along with spawning spiked-circles on the ground, deal damage until phase HP again to move on.
    • Circles can be dealt with by using defensives or

⬥ Magic bombs will also spawn from the red portal in the center dealing low magic damage.
⬥ Two Chaos Demon Savages will spawn kill them to proceed to phase 3.

⬥ Eterna re-appears with all mechanics listed previously, deal damage until she is dead to move on to the next room.
⬥ The red portal in the center fires a spout into the player, dealing no damage and placing a bar over their head.
    • When this bar depletes, a 5x5 area around the player will become engulfed in smoke, dealing more damage the longer you stand inside.

Note: All of these runs are done on release and are to be taken as a quick reference for the time being. As time progresses, proper example kills with much better handling of mechanics will be posted.
